bacteria_entry_lambda.description: per-vessel probability rate of a new Bifidobacterium longum entering nearby (Poisson process); no literature value found, kept deliberately low and adjustable; set to 0 for the mechanism-4-only baseline (no bacteria/therapy) test

petrinet_global_seed.description: base seed for deterministic per-cell Petri-net streams

petrinet_entry_csv.description: manual bacterial entry schedule; empty disables scheduled input

petrinet_demo_vacuolar_bacteria.description: hard-coded t=0 vacuolar entry per target tumor cell; zero disables

petrinet_metrics_csv.description: optional per-cell xenophagy time-series output path

petrinet_uptake_csv.description: optional extracellular-agent uptake audit output path

petrinet_metrics_interval.description: xenophagy metrics sampling interval; non-positive disables

bifidobacterium_enabled.description: enable recruit_bacteria() spawning of the original (non-Gal8) Bifidobacterium_longum near vessels

bifidobacterium_gal8_enabled.description: enable recruit_bacteria() spawning of the engineered Bifidobacterium_longum_Gal8 (our own Gal-8 fusion-protein construct) near vessels. Independent of gal8_cd4_effect_enabled below -- this bacterium can be spawned and carry gal8_amount with that switch off, and will simply have no effect on any T cell

gal8_cd4_effect_enabled.description: DISABLED by user request (default false). Independently gates whether CD4 T cells read nearby Gal-8 (sum_nearby_gal8()) and whether that reading does anything to CD4 cycle-entry/apoptosis (cd4_gal8_net_growth_rate()) -- see phenotype_function() in custom.cpp. Deliberately decoupled from bifidobacterium_gal8_enabled: with this off, Bifidobacterium_longum_Gal8 can exist and carry Gal-8 with zero effect on any T cell, however many of them are nearby. Flip to true to re-enable the mechanism -- all underlying code is intact, nothing was deleted

gal8_amount_fixed.description: PLACEHOLDER -- every Bifidobacterium_longum_Gal8 carries this SAME fixed Gal-8 amount at creation (no per-bacterium distribution -- the collaborator's E_required(theta) numbers turned out to answer a different question, intracellular Gal8-NDP52 binding for the bacterium's own xenophagy evasion, not extracellular secretion to affect CD4 T cells, so they are not used here; see chat writeup). STILL a.u., not a real molecule count -- the CD4 dose-response below runs on this placeholder scale, NOT a calibrated one, until a real per-bacterium extracellular-secretion estimate is available.

gal8_effect_radius.description: radius within which a Bifidobacterium_longum_Gal8's carried Gal-8 contributes to a T cell's local exposure; matches the bacterial_uptake_distance convention in config/petrinet/parameters.xml (20 micron)

cd4_gal8_prolif_Pmax.description: fast-saturating GAL-8 PROMOTION term ceiling for CD4 cycle-entry rate perturbation r(C,t)=Pmax*C/(C+Kp) - Irate*t*C/(C+Ki). Least-squares fit (pure-Python grid+coordinate-descent, no scipy available) to the two CD4 CCK-8 files (Row A=24h, Row B=44h; 0.05/0.2/0.5 uM), R^2=0.92 on the 6 (dose,time) points -- see chat writeup for the fit, residuals, and its known miss on the single highest-SD data point (0.05uM/24h, SD=21.9%)

cd4_gal8_prolif_Kp.description: half-max concentration for the promotion term (fitted)

cd4_gal8_prolif_Irate.description: rate at which the INHIBITION term's effective ceiling grows with cumulative exposure time t (hours) -- captures the CCK-8 data's clear pattern of low-dose promotion at 24h flipping to net decline by 44h, and the much steeper 24h-to-44h drop at 0.5uM than at lower doses (fitted)

cd4_gal8_prolif_Ki.description: half-max concentration for the inhibition term (fitted)

cd4_cd8_help_max.description: PLACEHOLDER ceiling on CD8 cycle-entry rate when in full contact with a PD-1lo_CD4_Tcell (the IL-2-mediated 'CD4 help' pathway; literature -- see chat -- confirms CD4-derived IL-2 drives CD8 clonal expansion in tumors, but gives no PDAC-specific rate constant). Anchored to the same order of magnitude as the macrophage/Treg/CAF proliferation ceilings below (~2-3 day doubling time under maximal engagement), pending better calibration

macrophage_prolif_max.description: ceiling on macrophage cycle-entry rate when in full contact with myCAF (CSF1 proxy -- literature: CAF-induced macrophage proliferation sustains TAM number in PDAC). Back-calculated from a PDAC-specific Ki67+ macrophage fraction (~10-20%) via a rough S/G2/M-window-duration argument (~10h Ki67+ window / ~0.15 fraction =~67h doubling time) -- see chat writeup

treg_prolif_max.description: PLACEHOLDER ceiling on Treg cycle-entry rate driven by local TGF_beta (literature: Treg in-situ expansion in tumors is well documented and TGF-beta-dependent, but no PDAC-specific rate constant found). Anchored to the same order of magnitude as macrophage_prolif_max pending better calibration

mycaf_prolif_max.description: PLACEHOLDER ceiling on myCAF cycle-entry rate, driven by TGF_beta (Ohlund et al. myCAF/iCAF dichotomy). Anchored to the same order of magnitude as macrophage_prolif_max pending better calibration

icaf_prolif_max.description: ceiling on iCAF cycle-entry rate, driven by its OWN secreted IL6 (autocrine loop). Deliberately set LOWER than mycaf_prolif_max/macrophage_prolif_max (1/3 of that value) because a full 15-day test run showed this specific autocrine loop -- unlike every other proliferation term in this model -- has no external limiting input (more iCAF directly makes more of its own driving signal), so it needs a lower ceiling to compensate even with the pressure-brake below added at the same time -- see chat writeup for the 34.7x runaway iCAF growth this fixes

stromal_myeloid_pressure_half_max.description: half_max for pressure-based cycle-entry suppression on macrophage/myCAF/iCAF, reusing the exact value already established/calibrated for the 6 tumor-lineage types (0.25) for consistency

cd8_treg_brake_max.description: ceiling on how much contact with Treg can suppress CD8 cycle-entry rate (IL-2 competition proxy -- Tregs documented as the literature brake on T-cell quorum sensing via superior IL-2 receptor affinity). Set equal to cd4_cd8_help_max so Treg contact can, at saturation, fully cancel out CD4 help

treg_self_limit_max.description: ceiling on how much Treg-Treg contact suppresses further Treg cycle entry (proxy for the reciprocal IL-2 quorum-sensing equilibrium between Tregs and IL-2-producing CD4 cells described in the literature)

insulin_fasting_pM.description: fasting blood insulin baseline, mid-range of the clinical normal fasting range 2-25 mU/L =~ 14-174 pM

insulin_peak_fold.description: PLACEHOLDER -- postprandial insulin peak as a multiple of fasting baseline. Literature confirmed the qualitative pattern (rises after a meal, peaks within ~30-90min, returns to baseline within ~2-3h) but no precise fold-change number for a normal (non-diabetic, non-injected) physiological meal response was found; 5x is a commonly-cited rule-of-thumb order of magnitude, not a specific citation

glp1_fasting_pM.description: fasting plasma GLP-1, literature value ~15 pmol/L

glp1_peak_fold.description: postprandial GLP-1 peak / fasting, from literature values (peak ~40 pmol/L / fasting ~15 pmol/L)

cck_fasting_pM.description: fasting plasma CCK, literature value ~0.5-1 pmol/L

cck_peak_fold.description: postprandial CCK peak / fasting, from literature values (mixed-meal peak ~3-5 pmol/L / fasting ~1 pmol/L, mid-range of the reported 3-15 pmol/L peak range across different studies/meal compositions)

cck_enabled.description: DISABLED by user request (default false), temporary -- suspected contributor to a reintroduced tumor-growth-slowdown/initial-dip issue seen after adding CCK's myCAF-fibrosis effect (see chat writeup). Gates whether vessels ever secrete CCK (update_hormone_secretion() in custom.cpp); with this off the CCK field decays to ~0 within ~20-30min of run start and stays there, so the myCAF,CCK,... rules in cell_rules.csv see essentially no signal for the rest of the run. Does not affect insulin or GLP1. Flip to true to re-enable -- all underlying code/rules are intact, nothing was deleted

hormone_circadian_amplitude.description: PLACEHOLDER -- fractional amplitude of the ~24h circadian modulation shared by insulin/GLP1/CCK (literature confirms real circadian rhythmicity for all three -- insulin/GLP1 'in phase' with each other, higher daytime/evening and lower overnight; CCK's acrophase instead falls in the dark/night period, opposite phase, see update_hormone_secretion() in custom.cpp -- but no specific amplitude number was found for any of them)

hormone_secretion_rate.description: vessel secretion_rate shared by insulin/GLP1/CCK. Matched to the same order of magnitude as this model's existing vessel oxygen(200)/glucose(100) secretion rates -- an initial value of 1.0/min was tested and found far too weak (domain-mean concentration collapsed to ~1-7 pM regardless of target, since diffusion+decay away from the sparse vessel points dominated); 150/min was empirically found to let the domain-mean concentration actually approach its time-varying secretion_target. Not itself a literature-calibrated number, just an engineering fix so the mechanism is numerically live

insulin_prolif_max.description: ceiling on insulin-driven tumor cycle-entry rate (PI3K/Akt/mTOR promotes PDAC proliferation). Reuses the existing glucose-driven cycle-entry ceiling (7.2e-4) for consistency with this model's established tumor cycle-entry scale

insulin_prolif_half_max.description: half-max for insulin's proliferation/anti-apoptosis/anti-xenophagy effects; placed at the fasting baseline (insulin_fasting_pM) so the response is centered in the normal physiological range, not requiring frank hyperinsulinemia to engage

glp1_xenophagy_half_max.description: half-max for GLP-1's xenophagy-promotion effect; placed between fasting (15) and postprandial peak (40) so the effect engages over the normal meal-response range
